removeCredential.subject: Credential removed
removeCredential.body: An authentication credential was removed from your account on {date} from {ipAddress}.
removeCredential.disclaimer: If you did not make this change, contact your administrator immediately.

updateCredential.subject: Credential updated
updateCredential.body: An authentication credential was changed on your account on {date} from {ipAddress}.
updateCredential.disclaimer: If you did not make this change, contact your administrator immediately.

permanentLockout.subject: Account permanently locked
permanentLockout.body: Your account was permanently locked following repeated failed sign-in attempts on {date}.
permanentLockout.disclaimer: Contact your administrator to restore access to your account.

temporaryLockout.subject: Account temporarily locked
temporaryLockout.body: Your account was temporarily locked following repeated failed sign-in attempts on {date}.
temporaryLockout.disclaimer: Wait before trying again, or contact your administrator if you need help.

verifiableCredentialOffer.subject: Verifiable credential offer
verifiableCredentialOffer.body: Your administrator has made the credential {credentialName} available for your {realmName} account. Use the link below to claim it in your digital wallet.
verifiableCredentialOffer.disclaimer: If the link has expired, you may still be able to claim the credential through your account console. Contact your administrator if needed.

activationEmail.subject: Activate your {realmName} account
activationEmail.body: Activate your {realmName} account before signing in. Use the link below to complete the required account setup.
activationEmail.expiry: This link will expire in {minutes} minutes.
activationEmail.disclaimer: If you do not recognize this account activation, do not open or share the activation link. Contact support if requests are repeated or unclear.

magicLinkContinuation.subject: Log in to {realmName}
magicLinkContinuation.body: Someone requested a sign-in link for your {realmName} account.
magicLinkContinuation.instruction: After confirming, return to the browser tab where you started signing in. Keep that tab open until sign-in is complete.
magicLinkContinuation.disclaimer: Do not share this sign-in link. If you did not request it, do not open it. Contact support if requests are repeated or suspicious.

organizationInvitation.subject: Invitation to join {orgName}
organizationInvitation.body: You have been invited to join {orgName} on {realmName}.
organizationInvitation.noLink: Sign in to review your pending organization invitations, or contact the person who invited you.
organizationInvitation.disclaimer: If you do not want to join this organization, you can ignore this email.

workflowNotification.subject: Account notification
workflowNotification.preview: Please review this notification about your account.
workflowNotification.disableBody: Your account will be disabled in {days} days because of {reason}. Sign in to prevent this action.
workflowNotification.deleteBody: Your account will be deleted in {days} days because of {reason}. You will no longer be able to sign in with this account. Contact your administrator immediately if this is unexpected.
workflowNotification.questions: If you have questions, contact your {realmName} administrator.

contactHelp: If you need help, please contact

email-test.messageBody: This is a test email from {realmName}
email-test.disclaimer: This is a test email. Please ignore this message.

email-update-confirmation.messageBody: To update your {realmName} account with email address {newEmail}, click the link below
email-update-confirmation.disclaimer: If you did not request this change, do not confirm it. Review your account through your usual sign-in page and contact support if needed.

email-verification.messageBody: Someone has created a {realmName} account with this email address. If this was you, click the link below to verify your email address.
email-verification.disclaimer: If you do not recognize this account creation or verification request, do not verify the email address or share the link. Contact support if needed.

email-verification-with-code.messagePreview: Please verify your email address by entering in the following code
email-verification-with-code.messageBody: Please verify your email address by entering in the following code:
email-verification-with-code.disclaimer: Do not share this code. If you did not request this verification, do not use it. Contact support if requests are repeated or unclear.

event-login-error.messageBody: A failed login attempt was detected to your account on {date} from {ipAddress}.
event-login-error.disclaimer: If you did not make this sign-in attempt, review your account security through your usual sign-in page and change your password as a precaution. Contact support if attempts are repeated or suspicious.

event-remove-totp.messagePreview: OTP was removed from your {realmName} account
event-remove-totp.messageBody: OTP was removed from your account on {date} from {ipAddress}.
event-remove-totp.disclaimer: If you did not remove OTP yourself, immediately change your password through your usual sign-in page, review your sign-in methods, and contact support.

event-update-password.messageBody: Your password was changed on {date} from {ipAddress}.
event-update-password.disclaimer: If you did not change your password yourself, immediately reset it through your usual sign-in page and contact support.

event-update-totp.messagePreview: OTP was updated for your {realmName} account
event-update-totp.messageBody: OTP was updated for your account on {date} from {ipAddress}.
event-update-totp.disclaimer: If you did not update OTP yourself, immediately change your password through your usual sign-in page, review your sign-in methods, and contact support.

execute-actions.messagePreview: Your administrator has just requested that you update your {realmName} account by performing the following action(s)
execute-actions.messageBody: We have just created your {realmName} account. Please set your initial password by clicking on the link below.
execute-actions.resetPassword: If the link has already expired, try to reset you password with your email at our login page.
execute-actions.furtherActions: If you have any questions or think you are the wrong person receiving this email.
execute-actions.adminMessageBody: Your administrator has just requested that you update your {realmName} account by performing the following action(s):
execute-actions.adminMessageLink: Click on the link below to start this process.
execute-actions.adminIgnoreMessage: If you do not recognize this request, do not open the link. Verify the request with your administrator through a contact method you already know.

footer.disclaimer: This is a system message from {realmName} concerning an account, sign-in, security, or invitation function.

identity-provider-link.messagePreview: Someone wants to link your {realmName} account
identity-provider-link.messageBody: Someone wants to link your {realmName} account with {identityProviderDisplayName} account of user {username}. If this was you, click the link below to link accounts.
identity-provider-link.disclaimer: Only link accounts if you started the process yourself. Otherwise, do not confirm the link and review your account through your usual sign-in page. Contact support if needed. After linking, you can sign in to {realmName} through {identityProviderDisplayName}.

magic-link-email.messagePreview: Someone has requested a login link to {realmName}
magic-link-email.messageBody: Someone has requested a login link to {realmName}
magic-link-email.disclaimer: Do not share this sign-in link. If you did not request it, do not open it. Contact support if requests are repeated or suspicious.

organization-invite.messagePreview: You were invited to join {0} organization
organization-invite.messageBody: You were invited to join the {0} organization. Click the link below to join.
organization-invite.disclaimer: If you don't want to join the {0} organization, you can safely ignore this message.

otpEmail.messagePreview: Someone has requested access to your account
otpEmail.messageBody: Someone has requested access to your account. Your One-Time Password (OTP) is:
otpEmail.disclaimer: If you did not request this sign-in, do not share this code. As a precaution, change your password through your usual sign-in page and contact support if needed.

password-reset.messagePreview: Someone just requested to change your {realmName} account's credentials
password-reset.messageBody: Someone just requested to change your {realmName} account's credentials. If this was you, click on the link below to reset them.
password-reset.disclaimer: If you did not request this reset, do not open or share the link. This email alone does not change your password. Contact support if requests are repeated or suspicious.
